review.rationale: 保留原在场减伤/回初分支；死亡当前清除冰封及取消要求的受击分支真实执行，继承资格按已答的清除前快照记录，真实下一只登场继承延期。
review.singleBehavior: 在场减红/固50，回初敌正强分支授冰呪并正视负，否则自身红+50忽略自身负级；死亡清敌回合冰封。装备2569且当前敌真实魂印含秒杀则受击后即清回合冰封，无需使用该招或真实死亡；零红命中沿公共受击事件，MISS/无效不触发。下一只冰呪资格先读敌回合再清，不改原HP或造队友。
review.deferredBehavior: 存活场下为真实己方成员提供霜域血装；真实当回死亡换宠下场后给下一只3回冰呪，资格按本次清除前无回合已确认，当前只记录真实依赖不造队友。
review.trigger: 存活场下支援；当回合实际死亡切换，且本次死亡载荷清除之前对手无回合类效果。
futureMechanisms: 真实死亡切换与下一只状态转移

success.name: 4942/2141在场攻击及固定减半，百分比与真实伤害不减，免伤仍独立
success.assertion: test('4942/2141在场攻击及固定减半，百分比与真实伤害不减，免伤仍独立',()=>{for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent','true']){const values=[];for(const soul of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul});observe((e,c)=>{if(type!=='attack'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,1000,'减伤类型测试',type);},()=>turn(s,10200,type==='attack'?10127:20309));values.push(sum(s,type,1));}assert.ok(Math.abs(values[1]-values[0]*(['attack','fixed'].includes(type)?.5:1))<=1);}});

success.name: 4942/2141回合初无强化攻击增伤50%且忽略自身负级，等级原值不修改
success.assertion: test('4942/2141回合初无强化攻击增伤50%且忽略自身负级，等级原值不修改',()=>{const values=[];for(const atk of[0,-2,-6]){const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=atk;turn(s,10200,20309);values.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,atk);}assert.equal(new Set(values).size,1);const p=make({move:10200,index:-1});turn(p,10200,20309);assert.ok(values[0]>=sum(p)*1.48&&values[0]<=sum(p)*1.52);});

success.name: 4942/2141回合初有强化获得3回冰呪并视正为负，真实正级保持，回合内强化变化不重选分支
success.assertion: test('4942/2141回合初有强化获得3回冰呪并视正为负，真实正级保持，回合内强化变化不重选分支',()=>{const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(s,10200,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['冰呪'].end,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ice2141.boosted,true);const p=make({move:10200,index:-1});p.fighters[1].stages.def=-2;timer(p,0,'冰呪');turn(p,10200,20309);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(p));const q=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{spe:10}});turn(q,10200,20117);assert.equal(q.fighters[1].stages.atk,1);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].soulState.ice2141.boosted,false);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].effects['冰呪'],undefined);});

success.name: 4942/2141真实死亡清回合冰封，免异独立；下一只资格按清前无回合快照但不伪造队友
success.assertion: test('4942/2141真实死亡清回合冰封，免异独立；下一只资格按清前无回合快照但不伪造队友',()=>{for(const had of[false,true])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{spe:1,def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});s.fighters[1].effects=had?{攻击必中:{start:1,end:99}}:{};if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,10200,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(Object.keys(s.fighters[1].effects).length,0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],!immune);const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.iceInheritance2141;assert.equal(e.requiresActualNextAlly,true);assert.equal(e.pendingCondition,undefined);assert.equal(e.conditionConfirmed,true);assert.equal(e.hadRoundBeforeClear,had);assert.equal(e.eligible,!had);}});

success.name: 4942已答2569仅装备真实技能且当前敌真实魂印含秒杀时，未使用冰点也在受击后清回合冰封，活体不伪造死亡
success.assertion: test('4942已答2569仅装备真实技能且当前敌真实魂印含秒杀时，未使用冰点也在受击后清回合冰封，活体不伪造死亡',()=>{for(const mode of ['active','noSkill','noSoul','noInstant']){const s=battle({passive:mode!=='noSkill',soul:mode!=='noSoul',instant:mode!=='noInstant'});timer(s,1,'entryProbe');let received;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0)received={hp:c.a.hp,events:c.a.soulState.iceDefeatEvents2141?.slice()??[],clear:!c.t.effects.entryProbe,frozen:!!c.t.ailments['冰封']};},()=>turn(s,29444,19939));assert.ok(received.hp>0);const active=mode==='active';assert.equal(received.events.length,active?1:0);assert.equal(received.clear,active);assert.equal(received.frozen,active);if(active){assert.equal(received.events[0].reason,'received-attack-2569');assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.iceInheritance2141.requiresActualDeathExit,true);}if(mode==='noSkill')assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(s.fighters[0].pp,key(38523)),false);else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38523)],1);}});

success.name: 4942已答受击包含命中免红和整盾归零，MISS及整招无效无受击，属性招也不凭空触发
success.assertion: test('4942已答受击包含命中免红和整盾归零，MISS及整招无效无受击，属性招也不凭空触发',()=>{for(const mode of ['immune','shield','miss','invalid','status']){const s=battle();timer(s,1,'probe');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[0],9000,'2141-test');if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,1,'attackBlock');let count;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0)count=c.a.soulState.iceDefeatEvents2141?.filter(x=>x.reason==='received-attack-2569').length;},()=>turn(s,29444,mode==='status'?20044:19939));assert.equal(count,mode==='immune'||mode==='shield'?1:undefined,mode);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],['immune','shield'].includes(mode),mode);if(mode==='immune'||mode==='shield')assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);}});

success.name: 4942已答冰封免异失败不取消先清回合，继承条件始终按清前快照，只登记真实死亡下场依赖
success.assertion: test('4942已答冰封免异失败不取消先清回合，继承条件始终按清前快照，只登记真实死亡下场依赖',()=>{for(const had of [false,true])for(const immune of [false,true]){const s=battle();s.fighters[1].effects=had?{probe:{start:1,end:99}}:{};if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;let e;observe((event,c)=>{if(event==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0)e={request:{...c.a.soulState.iceInheritance2141},frozen:!!c.t.ailments['冰封'],cleared:!c.t.effects.probe};},()=>turn(s,29444,19939));assert.equal(e.cleared,true);assert.equal(e.frozen,!immune);assert.equal(e.request.hadRoundBeforeClear,had);assert.equal(e.request.eligible,!had);assert.equal(e.request.conditionConfirmed,true);assert.equal(e.request.pendingCondition,undefined);assert.equal(e.request.requiresActualNextAlly,true);assert.equal(e.request.requiresActualDeathExit,true);}});

success.assertion: test('4942基础4/5逐实例等级方向边界与15%成功失败，14四技能冻伤10%成功失败',()=>{for(const id of[4,5])for(const item of rows(id)){const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=(item.args[1]===100?1:32);seed++){const s=make({...item,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),side=id===4?0:1,k=keys[item.args[0]];turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[k]);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set(item.args[1]===100?[item.args[2]]:[0,item.args[2]]));const s=make(item),side=id===4?0:1,k=keys[item.args[0]];s.fighters[side].stages[k]=item.args[2]>0?6:-6;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],item.args[2]>0?6:-6);}for(const item of rows(14)){const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const s=make({...item,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冻伤']);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([true,false]));}});

success.assertion: test('4942两种冰点原生15与0命中值：64实际种子各零级负六级、PP先制行动顺序与零红，零命中不伪造成功',()=>{for(const id of [10210,38523]){const raw=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===id);assert.equal(raw.accuracy,id===10210?15:0);assert.equal(raw.alwaysHit,false);for(const grade of [0,-6]){let hits=0,misses=0;for(let i=0;i<64;i++){const seed=i<12?i+1:Math.imul(i+1,0x9e3779b1)>>>0,s=make({move:id,index:-1,hit:false,seed}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(id)];s.fighters[0].stages.acc=grade;const old=E.SOULS,order=[];let reason;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterUse'){order.push(c.a.side);if(c.a.side===0)reason=c.invalidReason;}}};try{turn(s,id,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,raw.priority);assert.equal(order[0],0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.moveDefinitions[key(id)].criticalChance,1/16);if(reason.miss)misses++;else hits++;}assert.equal(hits+misses,64);if(id===38523){assert.equal(hits,0);assert.equal(misses,64);}else{assert.ok(hits>0);assert.ok(misses>0);}}}});

success.name: 4942全部27招有序编译与原生2141状态，25招64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，两种冰点另核原生低零命中
success.assertion: test('4942全部27招有序编译与原生2141状态，25招64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，两种冰点另核原生低零命中',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4942.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:source.moves.filter(m=>![10210,38523].includes(m.id))}});for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>0&&s.fighters[0].hp<=9000);if([10210,38523].includes(m.id))assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);else{assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0&&s.fighters[1].hp<=9000);if(m.kind!=='status')assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ice2141.boosted,false);}});

success.name: 4942两种冰点原生15与0命中值：64实际种子各零级负六级、PP先制行动顺序与零红，零命中不伪造成功
success.assertion: test('4942两种冰点原生15与0命中值：64实际种子各零级负六级、PP先制行动顺序与零红，零命中不伪造成功',()=>{for(const id of [10210,38523]){const raw=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===id);assert.equal(raw.accuracy,id===10210?15:0);assert.equal(raw.alwaysHit,false);for(const grade of [0,-6]){let hits=0,misses=0;for(let i=0;i<64;i++){const seed=i<12?i+1:Math.imul(i+1,0x9e3779b1)>>>0,s=make({move:id,index:-1,hit:false,seed}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(id)];s.fighters[0].stages.acc=grade;const old=E.SOULS,order=[];let reason;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterUse'){order.push(c.a.side);if(c.a.side===0)reason=c.invalidReason;}}};try{turn(s,id,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,raw.priority);assert.equal(order[0],0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.moveDefinitions[key(id)].criticalChance,1/16);if(reason.miss)misses++;else hits++;}assert.equal(hits+misses,64);if(id===38523){assert.equal(hits,0);assert.equal(misses,64);}else{assert.ok(hits>0);assert.ok(misses>0);}}}});

success.assertion: test('4942/2569完整当前1个真实秒杀特性增加命中100并20%免PP成功失败，不再隔离效果',()=>{const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const s=enemy519(seed,null);turn(s,38523,20044);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);seen.add(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38523)]);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([0,1]));const p=make({move:38523,hit:false});turn(p,38523,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(38523)],0);});

success.name: 4942已答2569仅装备真实技能且当前敌真实魂印含秒杀时，未使用冰点也在受击后清回合冰封，活体不伪造死亡
success.assertion: test('4942已答2569仅装备真实技能且当前敌真实魂印含秒杀时，未使用冰点也在受击后清回合冰封，活体不伪造死亡',()=>{for(const mode of ['active','noSkill','noSoul','noInstant']){const s=battle({passive:mode!=='noSkill',soul:mode!=='noSoul',instant:mode!=='noInstant'});timer(s,1,'entryProbe');let received;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0)received={hp:c.a.hp,events:c.a.soulState.iceDefeatEvents2141?.slice()??[],clear:!c.t.effects.entryProbe,frozen:!!c.t.ailments['冰封']};},()=>turn(s,29444,19939));assert.ok(received.hp>0);const active=mode==='active';assert.equal(received.events.length,active?1:0);assert.equal(received.clear,active);assert.equal(received.frozen,active);if(active){assert.equal(received.events[0].reason,'received-attack-2569');assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.iceInheritance2141.requiresActualDeathExit,true);}if(mode==='noSkill')assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(s.fighters[0].pp,key(38523)),false);else assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38523)],1);}});

success.name: 4942已答受击包含命中免红和整盾归零，MISS及整招无效无受击，属性招也不凭空触发
success.assertion: test('4942已答受击包含命中免红和整盾归零，MISS及整招无效无受击，属性招也不凭空触发',()=>{for(const mode of ['immune','shield','miss','invalid','status']){const s=battle();timer(s,1,'probe');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[0],9000,'2141-test');if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,1,'attackBlock');let count;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0)count=c.a.soulState.iceDefeatEvents2141?.filter(x=>x.reason==='received-attack-2569').length;},()=>turn(s,29444,mode==='status'?20044:19939));assert.equal(count,mode==='immune'||mode==='shield'?1:undefined,mode);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],['immune','shield'].includes(mode),mode);if(mode==='immune'||mode==='shield')assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);}});

success.name: 4942已答冰封免异失败不取消先清回合，继承条件始终按清前快照，只登记真实死亡下场依赖
success.assertion: test('4942已答冰封免异失败不取消先清回合，继承条件始终按清前快照，只登记真实死亡下场依赖',()=>{for(const had of [false,true])for(const immune of [false,true]){const s=battle();s.fighters[1].effects=had?{probe:{start:1,end:99}}:{};if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;let e;observe((event,c)=>{if(event==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0)e={request:{...c.a.soulState.iceInheritance2141},frozen:!!c.t.ailments['冰封'],cleared:!c.t.effects.probe};},()=>turn(s,29444,19939));assert.equal(e.cleared,true);assert.equal(e.frozen,!immune);assert.equal(e.request.hadRoundBeforeClear,had);assert.equal(e.request.eligible,!had);assert.equal(e.request.conditionConfirmed,true);assert.equal(e.request.pendingCondition,undefined);assert.equal(e.request.requiresActualNextAlly,true);assert.equal(e.request.requiresActualDeathExit,true);}});

success.name: 4942/36与1101命中秒杀真实HP、免攻不拦秒杀，1101MISS自身死亡随机3槽PP归零全弱
success.assertion: test('4942/36与1101命中秒杀真实HP、免攻不拦秒杀，1101MISS自身死亡随机3槽PP归零全弱',()=>{for(const id of[36,1101]){const s=make(row(id));timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}const patterns=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=20;seed++){const s=make({...row(1101),hit:false,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);const cleared=s.fighters[1].moves.filter(k=>s.fighters[1].pp[k]===0);assert.equal(cleared.length,3);patterns.add(cleared.join(','));for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],-1);}assert.ok(patterns.size>1);const blocked=make(row(1101));timer(blocked,0,'skillBlock');turn(blocked,blocked.auditMoveId,20309);assert.ok(blocked.fighters[0].hp>0);assert.ok(blocked.fighters[1].hp>0);assert.equal(blocked.fighters[1].moves.filter(k=>blocked.fighters[1].pp[k]===0).length,0);});

success.assertion: test('4942/1959清回合冰封成功正常红伤，清失败或异常免疫时翻倍，1249回复与粉伤分开',()=>{const values=[];for(const mode of['success','none','immune']){const s=make(row(1959));if(mode==='none')s.fighters[1].effects={};if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);values.push(sum(s));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],mode==='success');}assert.ok(values[1]>=values[0]*1.98&&values[2]>=values[0]*1.98);for(const mode of['none','ailment','ban']){const s=make({...row(1249),hp:1000});if(mode!=='none')s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:1000+sum(s));const extra=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='percent');assert.equal(extra.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),mode==='none'?0:sum(s));}});
